layerNaming.rule: Public wrapper `Table`; private parts `.table-row` and `.table-cell` (leading period, lowercase, dash-separated). Each level exposes a `Content` slot.

Table.layout: GRID (single cell) wrapping a VERTICAL Content slot of rows

Content#1436:2.note: Restricted slot (allowPreferredValuesOnly) — only .table-row instances may be inserted. Maps to TableHeader/TableBody rows in code.

Cell#1430:0.note: Legacy single-cell swap from the first build, retained on the component. The Content (rows) slot is now the primary composition path.

notes: Outer chrome only: border + background + rounded corners; rows/cells supply their own dividers.
Reference instance ships a Head row (uds/surface/tertiary cells) followed by Body rows (uds/surface/primary cells).

.table-row.layout: VERTICAL wrapper; Content slot is HORIZONTAL (cells run left-to-right)

Content#1436:1.note: Restricted slot (allowPreferredValuesOnly) — only .table-cell instances may be inserted. Maps to a TableRow's TableCell/TableHead children.

notes: Structural row wrapper holding a horizontal run of .table-cell instances.
Header rows use Appearance=Head cells; body rows use Appearance=Body cells (set per-instance, not a row variant).
Row fill is an unbound white — bind to uds/surface/primary if a token is required.

Content#1436:0.note: Open slot — accepts any element (text, shapes, instances).

notes: 3 variants by Appearance: Body (surface/primary), Head (surface/tertiary), Footer (surface/quaternary). Default = Head.
Cell text is Inter Regular 16; vertically centered in a 160×24 cell (counterAxis CENTER).
Bottom border only acts as the row divider (replaces a full box border).
No internal padding (spacing/0) and square corners (radius/0); the wrapper owns the rounded corner clip.

structure.Table (Figma wrapper): table-container div + table — outer border, uds/radius/4, overflow-x-auto
structure..table-row: TableRow (tr); first row ≈ TableHeader > tr, remaining ≈ TableBody > tr
structure.Content slots: children at each level (table rows, row cells, cell content)

notes: Divider: Figma binds the bottom border on the cell; code applies it on TableRow via `border-b` with border-border (uds/border/primary) — same visual result.
Padding: aligned — TableCell and TableHead use p-0 to match Figma spacing/0; cell content supplies its own spacing.
Header fill: aligned — TableHead uses bg-accent (--accent = uds/surface/tertiary) to match Figma Head; weight is Regular (font-medium removed).
Surface: aligned — table-container uses bg-background (uds/surface/primary) to match the Figma Table fill.
Slot enforcement: Figma uses slot allowPreferredValuesOnly to restrict Table→.table-row and .table-row→.table-cell; code enforces the same nesting structurally via JSX.
